svg.title: Castaway: the island as a process monitor
svg.desc: A full-screen terminal process monitor for Castaway, a 10-hour lo-fi island video. Top right, CASTAWAY in big rounded box-drawing capitals, coral to sand to sea. Six bar meters, one per lane: castaway, cat, turtle, sea_sky, shore and garden. A music meter steps through the 20 bars of the theme in real time; a samples meter reads 0. Load average 0.33 0.33 0.33. The process table lists activities as processes with their tiers, weights, intervals and durations: python tools/serve.py at the root, then idle_music_nod, coconut_sip, sandcastle and the tide, ship_passes_unseen, message_in_bottle and its reply, turtle_visit, cat_visit, signal_hunt, delivery_drone, shark_nod and leave_any_time. A ship passes on core 3 while she sips a coconut on core 0; she never sees it.
